title: Nellie's Happy Stamp Day
markdown:
The sun stretched its fingers through the post office windows, waking Nellie the otter. "Today feels special," she thought. She hurried to her stamping station. Neat parcels waited. Nellie’s job was to stamp them. Today, a tiny acorn stamper! "This acorn will make the most wonderful stamps!" she whispered.

Miss Eaves, the postmistress, bustled in. "Good morning, Nellie! A busy day?"

"The busiest! And the most exciting!" Nellie giggled. A big parcel landed. It was for Willow Creek. Nellie dipped her acorn into sparkly blue ink. She pressed down. Oh dear! The acorn wobbled. Instead of a star, a dazzling, swirly pattern popped onto the parcel, twinkling!

"Oh my!" Nellie gasped.

Miss Eaves peered over. "My, my! That’s quite a stamp, Nellie. Very… grand! It looks like a tiny piece of the night sky."

Plink! The parcel zipped off. Soon, a message arrived from Willow Creek. The sender had loved the swirly star! "It's the most glamorous stamp I've ever seen! It made my whole day shine!"

Word spread. Parcels arrived from all over: "A stamp like Willow Creek's, please! We want a glamorous one too!" Nellie’s paws worked with happy speed. She added swooping swirls, shimmering dots, and glittering lines.

Bram the rook flapped in. "I can peck out extra details!" he squawked. His quick pecks added tiny dots.

"This is a bit tricky," Nellie admitted. One stamp looked like a funny smudge. Parcels piled up. Miss Eaves watched, her kind eyes thoughtful.

"Nellie," Miss Eaves said gently. "This excitement is wonderful, but the parcels are getting delayed." She tapped a tall stack. "Perhaps," she mused, "we could have a little contest."

Nellie’s ears perked up. "A contest?"

"Indeed," Miss Eaves smiled. "A 'Happy Stamp Contest'! The prize will be for the most creative picture that brings the most genuine joy."

Nellie thought hard. She remembered the happy flutter in Willow Creek. She thought about all the waiting parcels. Suddenly, a brilliant idea bloomed! "A simple sun!" she announced. "A bright, cheerful sun! Everyone loves a sunny day!"

She grabbed her acorn, dipped it into sunshine-yellow ink. Pop! With perfect control and a heart full of happy purpose, she stamped a perfect, beaming sun onto each parcel. The townsfolk saw the cheerful sun stamps. They smiled. They clapped with delight. A simple sun stamp, stamped with genuine delight, brought a wave of happiness to everyone. Nellie beamed. The post office was busy, but it was also filled with brilliant, gentle cheer. Today was, indeed, going to be AMAZING!
characters: Nellie the otter, Bram the rook, Miss Eaves
